alerts.title: Creatinine monitoring overdue while on TDF
alerts.message: Creatinine last recorded 478 days ago for a patient on TDF. Consider ordering repeat renal function monitoring.

{"art_regimen_decision":{"decision":"Continue","reason":"Patient is clinically well with suppressed viral load (40 copies/mL) and normal creatinine (88 umol/L) on TDF/3TC/DTG with no signs of toxicity."},"problems":[{"problem":"Stale renal monitoring on TDF (creatinine last checked 478 days ago)","action":"Order serum creatinine and eGFR today to screen for TDF nephrotoxicity per guideline requirement.","reason":"Guidelines require serum creatinine and eGFR screening for patients on TDF, and the last creatinine was over 15 months ago.","clinician_plan_for_this_problem":{"decision":"Not Addressed","explanation":"The clinician's plan of routine follow-up with no issues does not include ordering renal function tests despite TDF use."}},{"problem":"No evidence of current drug toxicity","action":"Continue TDF/3TC/DTG and document absence of toxicity symptoms at this visit.","reason":"Patient has no complaints, appears well on examination, and has normal creatinine and suppressed viral load.","clinician_plan_for_this_problem":{"decision":"Agree","explanation":"The clinician's plan to continue routine follow-up aligns with the absence of clinical or laboratory toxicity signals."}},{"problem":"Pharmacovigilance screening not documented","action":"Screen for DTG contraindications (diabetes, psychiatric history) and document adverse drug reaction assessment per pharmacovigilance guidelines.","reason":"Guidelines emphasize pharmacovigilance and DTG screening, and there is no documentation of contraindication screening since regimen initiation.","clinician_plan_for_this_problem":{"decision":"Gap","explanation":"The clinician plans routine follow-up but does not document pharmacovigilance or DTG contraindication screening as emphasized by guidelines."}}],"monitoring_plan":"- Serum creatinine and eGFR today (overdue by >15 months)
- Viral load per national schedule (last VL Oct 2025: 40 copies/mL, suppressed)
